scientific_choices.expected_effect: Reduce scattered votes without losing the GT centroid anchor; consensus alone could collapse to a wrong center.

scientific_choices.rationale: Hinge squared own-center distance minus squared nearest other-center distance plus0.1 of nearest GT-center spacing squared, divided by that spacing. Weight0.5. Unlike Euclidean-distance contrast, this retains a restoring gradient past rival centers. Coincident centers within0.001 native pixels cannot be distinguished by xy; omit those pairs and record ambiguous word counts.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Penalize cross-word voting with a scale-adaptive margin; no claimed optimal weights.

scientific_choices.expected_effect: Auditable paired objective/geometry diagnostics without a GT-assisted inference count.
